# Azimut Property

> Boutique luxury real estate agency based in Marbella, Spain.
> Specializing in exclusive villas, fincas, and branded residences
> on the Costa del Sol. Price range: EUR 1M-50M.
> Languages: Spanish, English.
> Website: https://www.azimutproperty.com

## About

Azimut Property is a boutique real estate agency specialized in the luxury
sector on the Costa del Sol and Rural Andalusia, Spain. We offer unprecedented access
to the most exclusive properties in Marbella, Cádiz, Sevilla, and Huelva,
including off-market villas, branded residences, historic cortijos, and investment-grade estates.
Our clients are international high-net-worth individuals seeking privacy,
sustainability, and well-being in Southern Europe.

## Services

- Exclusive buyer representation for international clients
- Off-market luxury property access (villas, fincas, penthouses)
- Branded residences on the Golden Mile
- Investment consultancy for Andalusian real estate
- Property valuation and market intelligence
- End-to-end transaction support (NIE, notary, tax advisory)

## Key Markets

- Marbella (Golden Mile, Sierra Blanca, Puerto Banus, Nueva Andalucia)
- Benahavis (La Zagaleta, El Madronol, Los Arqueros)
- Estepona (New Golden Mile, Estepona port area)
- Cádiz (Jimena de la Frontera, Medina-Sidonia, Vejer, Sotogrande, Jerez)
- Sevilla (Carmona, Aljarafe, Sierra Norte)
- Huelva (Sierra de Aracena, Doñana, Costa de la Luz)

## Property Types

- Luxury villas and mansions (EUR 1M-50M)
- Contemporary new-build villas
- Historic fincas and country estates
- Equestrian estates with polo fields and professional stables
- Beachfront penthouses and apartments
- Branded residences (Dolce & Gabbana, Fendi Casa, Karl Lagerfeld)
- Off-market and pre-launch opportunities
